scope: Prospective two-state deterministic and one-channel stochastic cosmological realizations, not all BHSM theories

gate_a.model: d = F X_2 + epsilon; fixed source response removed from d before fit
gate_a.requirements: N > 2 independent combinations; fixed rank(F)=2; known SPD covariance; fixed kernels and axis
gate_a.reference_calibration: chi-square N-2 only for known Gaussian covariance, fixed design and no fitted nuisances
gate_a.failure_scope: Reject the specific two-state deterministic realization

gate_b.null: rank(C_topo) <= 1 for a globally finite latent-amplitude response O=Mq
gate_b.separability_required: A single local field/noise type does not imply one global random amplitude after path integration
gate_b.primary_statistic: second largest eigenvalue of unprojected residual covariance in independently fixed dimensionless units, upper tail
gate_b.finite_sample_procedure: Predeclare full likelihood or selection-aware Monte Carlo/bootstrap, jointly propagating standard/noise covariance uncertainty; refit declared nuisance parameters within each replicate
gate_b.implemented_benchmark: iid Gaussian null with independently fixed standard/noise covariance and one fixed loading; 9999 null draws; seed 20260919; p=(1+exceedances)/(B+1)
gate_b.benchmark_limit: Not a calibration for a fitted composite rank-one null or correlated survey samples
gate_b.psd_projection: Forbidden for decisive test; preserve signed eigenvalues
gate_b.failure_scope: Reject the minimal one-channel stochastic realization only after nuisance and survey calibration is valid

joint_reporting: Two distinct null hypotheses with separate p<0.01 gates. Statistical independence is not assumed. Either-gate rejection has family-wise size at most 0.02 by the union bound; do not advertise it as a joint 1% test.
forbidden_rescues: independent state or amplitude per observable
increase state dimension or texture channel count after target inspection
drop bad bins or observables after inspection
change kernels or angular axis after inspection
fit standard covariance to enforce low rank
PSD clipping or projection to manufacture rank one
higher_channel_policy: Only a separate action-derived realization frozen before decisive target inspection; never rescue this m=1 test
required_target_freeze_before_unblinding: dataset release IDs, checksums, exposure history and training/target disjointness
observable definitions, source matching, redshift bins, angular masks, selection functions and missing-data policy
fixed equatorial ICRS axis RA=211.48 deg Dec=-12.81 deg and coordinate-transform convention
kernel file hashes, state anchor and basis transform, source subtraction and independent normalization
standard/noise covariance model, cross-survey covariance, nuisance priors and fitting degrees of freedom
fixed observable unit scales, covariance estimator and finite-sample simulation procedure
multiplicity policy, null-calibration coverage and predeclared power study
target_design_status: NOT_YET_FROZEN; structural preregistration is not an executable observational preregistration
prior_exposure: Existing R1/Pantheon+/2MRS results are development or calibration, not new blind targets
